 NorthEast United FC vs FC Goa Match Prediction & Analysis 
 In the final game of the day, NorthEast United welcome FC Goa, with the Highlanders enjoying the advantage of home support. The hosts will certainly be the happier of the two sides heading into this contest, having remained unbeaten in the competition and signed off for the international break with yet another victory. 
 Goa, meanwhile, have endured a difficult start to the campaign, which has ultimately led to the departure of their head coach. The Gaurs will therefore take the field on Saturday under new leadership, making this an intriguing encounter with plenty of uncertainty surrounding what to expect from both sides.
 Current Standings: NorthEast United sit second in the league standings with 11 points, while FC Goa are seventh with five points.
 Head-to-head Record: In 23 ISL meetings, FC Goa has the edge with seven wins to NorthEast’s four, with the remaining 12 ending in draws.
 TEAMS PREVIEW 
 NorthEast United FC Preview 
 NorthEast United will look to extend their unbeaten start to the MG ISL campaign when they take on Churchill Brothers on Saturday, with a win also offering them an opportunity to dislodge Mohun Bagan from the top of the standings. 
 The Highlanders have made an impressive start, recording three wins and two draws from their opening five matches. Juan Pedro Benali's men have been particularly solid defensively, keeping three clean sheets and conceding just twice in that run. 
 Their latest outing saw them secure a convincing 2-0 victory over Churchill Brothers, with Ethyan González opening the scoring before Antonio Moyano sealed the win with a stoppage-time strike. The result extended their unbeaten run to five games, giving them plenty of confidence heading into this encounter.
 NorthEast United  Probable starting Lineup 
 Gurmeet Singh (GK) ; Abdul Rabeeh A.K., Pramveer Ranbir, Eneko Satrústegui, Nikhil Barla, Antonio Moyano, Mayakkannan Muthu, Macarton Louis Nickson, Jithin M.S., Ethyan González and Alaeddine Ajaraie.
 FC Goa Preview 
 The Gaurs have made an inconsistent start to the campaign, collecting five points from their opening four matches with one win, two draws and one defeat. Their first two outings ended in identical 1-1 draws before they finally secured their maiden victory against bottom-placed Inter Kashi. 
 However, they headed into the international break on a disappointing note, suffering a 2-1 home defeat to Bengaluru FC, with the decisive goal arriving deep into stoppage time. The result further compounded their struggles and eventually led to Gouramangi Singh stepping down as head coach. He has since been replaced by Ángel Viadero, who brings experience from coaching several clubs in Spain.
 Viadero's immediate priority will be to address Goa's attacking shortcomings. Despite enjoying an average of 57% possession, the Gaurs have struggled to create clear-cut chances and convert their dominance into goals. Nevertheless, Chiki's contribution in front of goal offers some encouragement. 
 The forward has scored decisive goals in two of Goa's first three league outings, taking his tally to four goals in six appearances across competitions. Viadero will hope to build on that attacking threat while finding ways to make his side more productive in the final third.
 FC Goa Probable starting Lineup 
 Jackson (GK) ; Isak Vanlalruatfela, Franchu, Udanta  Singh, H.T. Singh, A. Vallejo, R.W. Kharbudon, Alex Zalaya,  Jhingan, K.A. Singh, Chiki
 NORTHEAST UNITED FC vs FC GOA 
 Winning Prediction 
 This has been a closely contested rivalry over the years, with FC Goa holding a slight overall advantage, although a significant number of meetings have ended in draws. However, NorthEast United will take confidence from their recent form and impressive home record, having gone unbeaten in their last six MG ISL matches at the venue, including five victories. 
 Goa, meanwhile, have had mixed fortunes on the road. That said, the Gaurs have reasons to be optimistic, having won this exact fixture 2-0 last season and remained unbeaten in their last four ISL visits to the venue. Considering these contrasting records, this promises to be a closely fought encounter, but NorthEast United should have enough to at least extend their unbeaten run.
 We predict draw (1-1).
